title: GregTech Cardboard Boxes
description: An addon for GTCEu that adds Cardboard Boxes as a storage option
body:
An addon for [GTCEu](https://modrinth.com/mod/gregtech-ce-unofficial) that adds a Cardboard Box as an extension of the mod's Crates. It only holds 9 slots, but can be mass produced relatively cheaply.

![A screenshot of many cardboard boxes on top of eachother, some are taped up and some are not, there are also many pieces of cardboard strewn about](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/d23c285cd82c37ee7fd145cf1e890200fa108743_0.webp)

Cardboard Boxes can also be broken by hand, unlike Crates.

This also adds a Crate Taper, a machine that will automatically tape up any Crate or Box in front of it, provided it has been supplied with a sufficient amount of Duct Tape.

![A screenshot showing the player using a button to activate a machine that applies tape to a crate in front of it](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/1195d83b7f64134454b6cd03b8c91b6fe29ed763_0.webp)
Recipes.

![A screenshot of recipes for a cardboard box, cardboard, and a crate taper](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/309446e00aea270f11eb0cdfdcb1a514f2471a06.png)

Also includes fixes to an issue in base GTCEu where breaking a taped crate without the proper tool will delete all of its contents and also an issue with tape overlay syncing.

**Future additions/to-do (possibly):**

- Option to make Crates and/or Boxes function without needing to be taped
- Option to make all Crates tapable by hand
- Port to GTCEu Modern
- Any other feature I may want to add to GTCEu involving cardboard and/or containers
